item.title: WordPress Is Colliding With AI — and Nobody Had ‘None’ on Their Bingo Card
item.description: WordPress's market share is slipping, the 'None' category just moved for the first time, and developers are having the most fun they've had building websites in years.

item.title: WordPress 7.0 RC1 Ships Despite Core Committer Concerns Over Release Readiness
item.description: WordPress 7.0 RC1 shipped on March 24 with a new fix for real-time performance issues and two new features — but not before core committers questioned whether the release was ready to ship.

item.title: The WP Community Collective Publishes Open Source Contributor Pay Standard
item.description: The WP Community Collective has published a five-level pay framework for open source contributors, the first publicly versioned compensation standard for the WordPress ecosystem.

item.title: Elementor Launches Angie, a Free AI Plugin for Building Custom WordPress Functionality
item.description: After months of testing, Elementor has launched Angie, its agentic AI plugin for WordPress, letting users build custom widgets, snippets, and apps from plain-language prompts.

item.title: WordPress Security Team’s 6.9.2 Retrospective Details Checklist Gap Behind 6.9.4 and Backporting Tensions
item.description: A WordPress Security Team retrospective on the 6.9.x releases details the checklist gap behind 6.9.4 and tensions with project leadership over backporting.

item.title: WordPress AI Connectors Lack Plugin-Level Controls — and the AI Team Is Already Working on It
item.description: The WP World's Marcus Burnette raised concerns about unchecked plugin access to WordPress AI Connectors. The AI Team is building out two features to address it.

item.title: Matt Mullenweg Calls for WordPress 7.0 Delay to Introduce Database Table for Real-Time Collaboration
item.description: WordPress 7.0 won't ship during Contributor Day at WordCamp Asia next week after Matt Mullenweg called for a delay to get real-time collaboration's database architecture right.

item.title: SWORD Wins CloudFest Hackathon 2026
item.description: SWORD took the overall prize at CloudFest Hackathon 2026, with Universal Access Browser Extension placing second and Frugal AI third. This year’s event saw 101 attendees from 20 countries hack 10 projects.

item.title: WordCamp Asia 2026 Set for Mumbai Next Week Without Live WordPress 7.0 Release
item.description: WordCamp Asia organizers have pivoted Contributor Day following news that WordPress 7.0 will be delayed, pulling the planned live release from the flagship event's schedule.

item.title: PressConf Returns Next Week. Here’s What’s Bringing People Back.
item.description: Zack Katz and Sandra Kurze both loved PressConf 2025. Here's why they're making the trip back to Tempe next week, and what they're hoping to get out of year two.
